title: 第十九章 武王之秘第二十章 帮忙
content_zh:
彼河大厦，一共二十一层，在洛津市众多的写字楼或者是各种产业楼，彼河大厦一点都不起眼。
但在黑拳界，彼河大厦在全世界还是有一点名号的。
表面上看彼河大厦是一个健身娱乐中心，实际上这里是一个顶级的地下黑拳场所。华夏著名的黑拳擂台，太平擂台就在这里。
地下黑拳不一定就在地下，彼河大厦的黑拳还真的在地下。
彼河大厦地下黑拳场占地不但宽广，一切设施都极为齐全。在这里不但可以看见最刺激的拳击比赛，还可以得到最顶级的享受。
此刻在黑拳赛台上，一名身材高大的黑人正和一名看起来较为瘦弱的男子战在一起。
擂台周围至少有两三百人在疯狂呐喊助威，随着赛台上两名正在战斗的选手身上鲜血飞溅，台下的呐喊声愈发狂热起来。
赛台斜上方的一个包厢中，一名身穿短袖金衫的男子看着赛台上的疯狂比战斗，却是微微有些皱眉。别人眼里的精彩比斗，在他看来却是比赛档次有些下降了。
一名长发青年走到包厢门口，轻轻的敲了一下门。在得到允许后，他小心的走进来弯下腰低声说道，“生爷，何山失踪七个小时了。”
原本有些皱眉的金衫男子听到这话，转头盯着门口的青年语气低沉的说道，“何山是不是去拿东西了吗？”
“是的，当时时锦姗背着重创的斐启离开，我交代他必须要在六点之前做干净，然后将东西拿回来。但在六点之后，就再也无法联系到何山。何山失踪后，我们一直在寻找他的去向，到现在为止，依然没有任何消息。”青年恭谨说道。
“立即发布太平通缉令，通缉何山，同时将时锦姗的去向找到，无论生死。还有，我要完整无缺的看到何山带走的东西。”男子放下手中的黄酒，缓声的说道。
“是，生爷。”长发青年赶紧一躬身退了出去，他很清楚生爷的声音越是平缓，那就代表着心里的愤怒越强。
何山一直是生爷的左膀右臂，这次居然为了时锦姗身上的东西逃走了，难怪生爷愤怒。
至于何山被杀，那根本就是不可能的事，何山那可是生爷手下的得力干将，如果那斐启没有受伤之前，也许还可以对付何山。斐启中枪重伤，时锦姗要对付何山，那就是一个笑话。
……
“启哥，你醒了？”黑暗中的时锦姗听到身边动静，立即惊喜道。
“这是哪里？”一个略显沙哑的虚弱声音响起。
时锦姗赶紧说道，“这是洛津市的一个下水道里面，彼郑生的人盯得太紧了，我不敢离开洛津。”
“我的枪伤……”男子下意识的摸了摸中枪的地方。

时锦姗赶紧说道，“我们运气比较好，在潭杏堂遇见了一个很厉害的外科医生，他帮你取了子弹。”
“啊……不好……”男子似乎想起了什么，立即叫道。
“怎么了？启哥。”时锦姗赶紧扶住男子。
“那个医生救了我的命，他应该被彼郑生的人杀了。”男子似乎知道事情无法挽回，语气冷静下来，同时带着深深的愧疚。
content_en:
The Bihe Building has a total of twenty-one floors. Among the many office buildings or various industrial buildings in Luojin City, the Bihe Building is inconspicuous at all.
But in the black boxing world, Bihe Building still has a bit of a reputation around the world.
On the surface, Bihe Building is a fitness and entertainment center, but in fact it is a top underground black boxing venue. The famous black boxing arena in China, the Taiping Arena is here.
The underground black boxing is not necessarily underground. The black boxing in Bihe Building is really underground.
The underground black boxing ring in Bihe Building not only occupies a large area, but also has all the facilities. Here you can not only see the most exciting boxing matches, but also get the highest level of enjoyment.
At this moment, in the black boxing ring, a tall black man was fighting with a thin-looking man.
There were at least two to three hundred people around the ring shouting and cheering crazily. As blood splattered on the two contestants fighting on the ring, the shouts from the audience became more and more fanatical.
In a box diagonally above the stage, a man wearing a short-sleeved golden shirt frowned slightly while watching the crazy battle on the stage. What others saw as a wonderful fight seemed to him like the level of the competition had dropped somewhat.
A young man with long hair walked to the door of the box and knocked gently. After getting permission, he walked in carefully, bent down and whispered, "Master Sheng, He Shan has been missing for seven hours."
When the man in gold shirt who was frowning heard this, he turned to stare at the young man at the door and said in a low voice, "Did He Shan go get something?"
"Yes, at that time, Shi Jinshan left Fei Qi, who was seriously injured, and I told him that he had to clean up before six o'clock and get his things back. But after six o'clock, He Shan could no longer be contacted. After He Shan disappeared, we have been looking for his whereabouts, and so far, there is still no news." The young man said respectfully.
"Immediately issue a Taiping arrest warrant to arrest He Shan. At the same time, find the whereabouts of Shi Jinshan, whether alive or dead. Also, I want to see everything that He Shan took away intact." The man put down the rice wine in his hand and said slowly.
"Yes, Master Sheng." The long-haired young man quickly bowed and retreated. He knew very well that the calmer the voice of Master Sheng, the stronger the anger in his heart.
He Shan has always been Mr. Sheng's right-hand man, but this time he actually ran away for Shi Jinshan's belongings. No wonder Mr. Sheng was angry.
As for He Shan being killed, that was simply impossible. He Shan was a capable officer under Mr. Sheng. If Na Fei Qi hadn't been injured, he might have been able to deal with He Shan. Fei Qi was seriously injured by a gunshot, and Shi Jinshan wanted to deal with He Shan. That was a joke.
…
"Brother Qi, are you awake?" Shi Jinshan, who was in the darkness, heard the movement around her and immediately said in surprise.
"Where is this?" A weak, slightly hoarse voice sounded.
Shi Jinshan said quickly, "This is in a sewer in Luojin City. Bi Zhengsheng's people are keeping a close eye on me. I dare not leave Luojin."
"My gunshot wound..." The man subconsciously touched the place where he was shot.
Shi Jinshan said quickly, "We were lucky. We met a very good surgeon at Tanxingtang, and he helped you remove the bullet."
"Ah... not good..." The man seemed to have remembered something and immediately shouted.
"What's wrong? Brother Qi." Shi Jinshan quickly supported the man.
"That doctor saved my life. He should be killed by Bi Zhengsheng's people." The man seemed to know that the matter was irreversible, and his tone was calm, but at the same time he was deeply guilty.
